messages:
maria (Support): customer hitting intermittent 502s in the UI since ~09:12 PDT. they pasted the UI request id: req_9f8a7c2b and say it fails consistently when sending long prompts. attaching initial note from customer.
kevin (SRE): can you ask for a HAR + console log and a curl repro? quick checklist: preserve network log, reproduce, save HAR. we need the request headers + response body for req_9f8a7c2b.
anna (Eng): also request the browser + version, any extensions, and steps they used (exact clicks/inputs). often adblock or corp proxies cause this.
maria (Support): will send step-by-step to customer. preparing a prefilled curl they can run to reproduce. include x-request-id header so we correlate.
maria (Support): message to customer: "Please follow the steps below and upload the bundle to the link I provide. If you prefer, paste the HAR here." :point_down:

1) Open Chrome (or Brave) -> three dots -> More tools -> Developer tools.
2) Network tab -> check 'Preserve log'.
3) Console tab -> keep open.
4) Reproduce the error.
5) Right-click the network list -> 'Save all as HAR with content'.
6) In Console, right-click -> 'Save as...' to capture logs, or take a screenshot of any stack traces.
7) ZIP the HAR + console text + a short note about steps you took and whether incognito changes anything.

Prefilled curl (replace <TOKEN>):
```bash
curl -v 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'x-request-id: req_9f8a7c2b' \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<paste the long prompt here>"}],"stream":false}'
```

maria (Support): also included this short note: "If you see CORS errors in the console, please still upload the HAR — the network request/response headers are what we need."
support-bot: Upload URL (expires in 24h): https://uploads.redwood.com/exp/abc123   :link:  

customer (via DM to maria): "Done, uploaded har_bundle_2024-05-17.zip"
maria (Support): received file and forwarded to SRE + Eng. attaching link: https://uploads.redwood.com/exp/abc123/har_bundle_2024-05-17.zip
kevin (SRE): downloaded and checked req_9f8a7c2b — server returned 502 with upstream id 0x7a3fde, response body shows java stack trace from envoy upstream. also see intermittent TLS handshake issues in the HAR.
anna (Eng): thanks. can you paste the exact request/response headers for the failing call? I want to verify the model variant and content-length.
kevin (SRE): headers:
- :method: POST
- :path: /v1/chat
- x-rw-req-id: req_9f8a7c2b
- authorization: Bearer <redacted>
- content-length: 12345
response:
- status: 502
- server: envoy
- x-upstream-id: 0x7a3fde

anna (Eng): looks like large payload + occasional upstream timeout. i'll try reproducing with the same payload behind our staging gateway. in the meantime, maria can you ask the customer to try incognito and disable extensions? also ask if they are on a corporate VPN.
maria (Support): asked customer to try incognito + disable adblock + reproduce. sent a short checklist and the curl command to run in their terminal and paste stderr if it errors. :thumbsup:

kevin (SRE): created an incident note and linked request id req_9f8a7c2b to the trace. adding this to the postmortem if it recurs.
anna (Eng): thanks — i'll start a focused run against staging with identical prompt size and share logs here when I have them.
maria (Support): closing loop with customer: "we have the HAR and engineers are investigating. if you can try incognito + curl and paste results that helps speed things up."
kevin (SRE): quick tip for future asks: include a tiny curl with `-H 'x-request-id: <id>'` so we can immediately map logs. saves two back-and-forths.
maria (Support): noted. :white_check_mark:
